the-control-population-is-identical-at-a.note: the layout neither adds nor removes a control as the viewport gets shorter — 12 cells, one number

detail.relationTo671: 671 recorded zero-sized controls as a census blind spot. These two are zero at EVERY height, so they are a constant property, NOT something a short viewport did.

the-two-zero-sized-controls-are-constant.note: do not read 'zero' as 'squeezed away' — that is 682's mistake once more

exactly-one-control-deforms-with-height-.note: one control out of the whole population changes size across 12 heights

detail.sizes24x24_and_36x18: each track's three nav buttons are NOT all the same size — a 36x18 one sits among 24x24 ones. This is heterogeneity WITHIN a data key, and it is constant in height — a different axis from 'deforms with height'.

two-data-keys-carry-two-different-sizes-.note: a same-key-different-size population, the size-side twin of 673's 异类合并 (which was name-side)

detail.rule: the rail stops overflowing where clientHeight (H-52) reaches the content height 284 — i.e. H = 336. scrollH itself tracks max(284, clientH), so it reads 284 only while the rail is actually overflowing.
detail.whyNot360: 360 would have been the first non-overflowing SAMPLE, but it is not in this batch's height list — 300 and 400 straddle the derived 336.
detail.whyItMatters: 682 sampled 300 and 400, so it bracketed the threshold and never landed on it

the-threshold-is-52-plus-284-and-682s-gr.note: the threshold is measured from clientH == scrollH, not guessed

below-the-threshold-help-leaves-the-canv.note: two DIFFERENT failure modes, not two sizes of one

detail.why: overflow-y: visible means the rail paints outside its own box, so 帮助 leaves the canvas instead of being scrolled into view

the-spill-is-painted-outside-the-box-not.note: this is why the failure is 'not on the canvas', not 'on the canvas but unclickable'

both-widths-agree-on-everything.note: compared PER HEIGHT. A union across heights trivially contains both sizes and proves nothing — that mistake was made twice in this batch
